meta.title: Penguin Survivors — Brotato-style arena survivor with penguins and DOOM gore
meta.description: Three penguins vs. zombies in a top-down arena survivor: 6 auto-firing weapons, a shop every round, and a level 1–100 that never resets.

hero.title: Penguin Survivors
hero.pitch: Three penguins. Three hundred zombies a round. Blood on the snow. A Brotato-style arena survivor where your progress never dies.
hero.bullet1: Cute penguins, DOOM-grade gore (toggle it if you must).
hero.bullet2: Six auto-firing weapons, a shop every round, builds that break the game.
hero.bullet3: Level 1–100 per hero, three difficulties, endless rounds.

demo.note: Demo: rounds 1–10 with Jack. Desktop browser only.

features.title: What you get
features.f1Text: Six slots fire on their own while you dodge. Fuse two identical weapons to reach tier IV.
features.f2Text: Between rounds, a merchant sells weapons, items and gear. Reroll, lock, sell, then fight again.
features.f3Text: Pick one of four stat cards at every level-up. Your level 1–100 carries over to every run.
features.f4Text: Easy halves enemy health and damage, Hard doubles them. Each hero unlocks Hard on their own.

faq.a2: US$ 4.99 on Steam is the planned price (final price TBD at release). Android price TBD.
faq.a3: Windows on Steam and Android on Google Play. The demo runs in desktop browsers.
faq.a4: No. The game uses text only; the merchant speaks through text.
faq.a5: English, Português (BR), Español and 简体中文 are planned for 1.0 (TBD).
faq.a6: Yes, DOOM-style gore, with a toggle: maximum, reduced or green goo.

desc.short: Penguin Survivors is a top-down arena survivor with penguins, zombies and DOOM-style gore: survive timed rounds, shop between them and build a six-weapon arsenal.
desc.long1: Three penguins, Jack, Bob and Lucia, hold the line against three hundred zombies a round. Each round is timed; when it ends a merchant opens shop and you buy, fuse and sell weapons, items and gear before the next one.
desc.long2: Six slots fire on their own while you dodge. Level-ups offer four stat cards, every hero levels from 1 to 100 and keeps it between runs, Hard difficulty raises the stakes, and the endless mode has no victory screen. The gore is DOOM-grade, with a toggle for maximum, reduced or green goo.

features.title: Key features
features.f1: Three heroes with their own weapons and superpowers: Jack (melee), Bob (firearms), Lucia (magic).
features.f2: Six auto-firing weapon slots, four tiers each, set bonuses and fusion.
features.f3: A merchant shop after every round: reroll, lock, sell and fuse.
features.f4: Level 1–100 per hero that never resets, plus Easy, Normal and Hard, with Hard unlocked per hero.
features.f5: Boss every 5 rounds, a 50-round campaign, then endless rounds with no victory screen.
features.f6: Controller, keyboard and touch; four languages; no voice acting.
